summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong-listed Next Day Disclosure Return disclosing a share repurchase. On June 26, 2026, the issuer repurchased 1,242,285 ordinary shares on the Nasdaq at USD 1.8067 per share, representing ~0.13% of pre-event issued shares; repurchased shares were held as treasury shares. The filing confirms board authorization and compliance with listing rules. No termination, premium, or advisor named. This is a routine open-market buyback under an existing program. Risk-arb angle not applicable as it is a capital return activity via buyback, not an event-driven deal.
